base_setup_commands: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git curl make golang-go
setup_runtime_commands: cd /workspace && go mod verify && go mod download
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'export GOPATH=/root/go && export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:${GOPATH}/bin:${PATH} && go version && echo ACTIVATION_OK'

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: go test automatically resolves and downloads test dependencies
runtime_profile.notes: Go 1.19.8 installed via apt (Debian bookworm). Project requires Go 1.19+ and CI uses 1.20. OPA v0.55.0 and Regal v0.11.0 installed for policy validation. Git, curl, and make installed as system dependencies.

notes: Base image: debian:bookworm. System packages git, curl, make, and golang-go are installed via apt. Go 1.19.8 is used (project requires 1.19+, CI uses 1.20). OPA and Regal are installed from GitHub releases for policy validation. The go mod download command caches all dependencies. GOPATH is set to /root/go. No special activation needed beyond setting GOPATH and PATH environment variables.
